items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: My sister, one of my sisters attempted to learn the piano when she was in high school.

ctx.x: My sister, one of my sisters attempted to learn the piano when she was in high school. And, uh, she completed one or two grades, but she didn't follow it through. And then I started on the piano. When was your first instrument? That was my first instrument. About how old were you?
About seven or eight years old.
